A University of Chicago research lab; GiveWell funded its water-treatment voucher work. GiveWell published 3 public models of its work; the most recent, from January 2024, puts it at **5.3× GiveDirectly (GW: 14× cash)**.

GiveWell states results as multiples of its cash benchmark. GiveDirectly itself scores about 2.6× that benchmark in GiveWell's own model, so GiveWell's multiples look 2.6 times smaller here, where everything is compared with GiveDirectly.

| [Vouchers Water Quality CEA [February 2023]](/development-innovation-lab/development-innovation-lab-vouchers-water-quality-february-2023) | GW | January 2023 | 5.6× GiveDirectly (GW: 15× cash) | 306, 13 kept fixed |
